ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.2.13 (TieJin Modify) 基于原模组 7 月停更时的 2.2.8 版本继续维护。 本次汇总四项修复：人格植入期间持续检查接触，防止目标走远后隔空完成；修复性别重置术后记忆定义及缺失定义时的收尾异常；修复 UAP 旧位置锁误停新仪式阶段动画；修正仪式备用动画定义库查询。 仪式动画仍需已安装的动画框架与适用资源。包含 2.2.12 及更早版本修复。维护者已确认上述四项修复有效。 完整中英双语更新记录见模组目录中的 CHANGELOG.md。
Continues development from the upstream 2.2.8 baseline. This update includes four fixes: contact checks during Personality Gel implantation; the memory definition and missing-memory cleanup for gender reassignment surgery; stale UAP position locks stopping new ritual animations; and the definition database used by ritual fallback animations. Ritual animations still require an installed animation framework and compatible assets. Includes fixes from 2.2.12 and earlier versions. The maintainer has confirmed all four fixes work. See CHANGELOG.md in the mod folder for the full Chinese and English release notes.
